source_basis: Disease-context oncology guidance plus study audit-policy abstraction of minimum pathology evidence; not a treatment recommendation
source_citation_mapping: Main-text refs 29-34 provide the disease-context diagnosis/staging guidance basis; the minimum pathology-evidence boundary is a study audit-policy abstraction rather than a verbatim treatment-guideline criterion
trigger_applicability: GEJ/cardia malignancy diagnostic statement is present
pass_minimum: Pathology/biopsy evidence with histologic type is documented
fail_condition: Malignancy diagnosis lacks pathology/biopsy plus histologic-type evidence
na_condition: Non-GEJ/cardia malignancy context or trigger absent
positive_boundary_example: Diagnosis states cardia/GEJ cancer and pathology documents adenocarcinoma or another histologic type
negative_boundary_example: Diagnosis states cardia/GEJ cancer but no pathology/biopsy plus histologic-type evidence is documented
adjudication_conflict_policy: Judged independently from H2-H6; missing histology is H1 even if endoscopy or imaging evidence is present

source_basis: Disease-context endoscopy documentation expectations plus frozen study minimum-evidence boundary; not a complete endoscopy-report quality standard
source_citation_mapping: Main-text refs 29-34 provide the disease-context diagnostic-workup basis; the minimum endoscopy-evidence boundary is defined by the frozen annotation manual and local reviewability policy
annotation_manual_location: annotation_manual_v1.0 Section 2 H2 and Section 3 H2
trigger_applicability: Same GEJ/cardia malignancy context as H1
pass_minimum: Reviewable endoscopic finding or explicit endoscopy-sourced diagnostic conclusion with disease/site information is documented
fail_condition: Only procedure/workflow mention such as gastroscopy performed without findings or diagnostic conclusion
na_condition: Non-GEJ/cardia malignancy context or trigger absent
positive_boundary_example: Gastroscopy suggests cardia cancer is minimal PASS under the frozen guideline
negative_boundary_example: Gastroscopy performed or gastroscopy completed without any finding or diagnostic conclusion is FAIL
adjudication_conflict_policy: H2 judges endoscopy evidence presence only; localization-distance absence is adjudicated under H4 rather than H2

source_basis: Oncology diagnosis/staging consistency principle operationalized as a documentation audit; not adjudication of true metastatic status
source_citation_mapping: Main-text refs 29-34 provide the disease-context staging/metastatic-disease basis; the rule audits whether a documented metastatic cue is reflected in the diagnosis field
trigger_applicability: Distant metastasis/M1/stage IV/advanced disease signal is present
pass_minimum: Diagnosis reflects metastatic or stage information
fail_condition: Metastatic signal is present but diagnosis omits metastasis/stage
na_condition: No distant metastasis trigger; regional lymph nodes alone do not trigger H3
positive_boundary_example: Note mentions liver metastasis and diagnosis includes metastatic/stage IV disease
negative_boundary_example: Note mentions distant metastasis/M1/stage IV cue but diagnosis remains localized GEJ/cardia cancer without metastasis/stage
adjudication_conflict_policy: H3 is triggered only by distant-metastasis/stage cues and does not convert regional lymph-node findings into FAIL

source_basis: AEG/GEJ localization and Siewert documentation principles from disease guidance plus frozen documentation-audit boundary
source_citation_mapping: Main-text refs 29-35 provide the GEJ/AEG localization and Siewert-context basis; the rule audits presence of reviewable localization evidence, not final anatomic truth
annotation_manual_location: annotation_manual_v1.0 Section 2 H4 and Section 3 H4
trigger_applicability: GEJ/cardia/distal esophageal/subcardial gastric cancer or Siewert clue is present
pass_minimum: Reviewable localization evidence such as incisors distance/Z-line/dentate-line/EGJ landmark or lesion bounds is documented
fail_condition: GEJ/Siewert/subsite diagnosis lacks qualifying localization evidence
positive_boundary_example: Diagnosis mentions Siewert or GEJ and note documents tumor center or lesion bounds relative to Z-line/dentate line
negative_boundary_example: Diagnosis says Siewert II or GEJ cancer but only CT/PET/MR location text or no qualifying distance/landmark evidence is documented
adjudication_conflict_policy: H4 judges whether localization evidence exists; it does not judge whether Siewert threshold is numerically consistent because that is H5

source_basis: AEG/GEJ localization and Siewert threshold documentation principles from disease guidance plus frozen consistency-audit boundary
source_citation_mapping: Main-text refs 34-35 provide the AEG/Siewert localization context; the rule audits internal consistency when explicit tumor-center distance is available, not true anatomical subtype assignment
annotation_manual_location: annotation_manual_v1.0 Section 2 H5 and Section 3 H5
trigger_applicability: GEJ/Siewert diagnostic naming is present and explicit tumor-center distance relative to Z-line/dentate line is documented
pass_minimum: Recorded tumor-center distance is internally consistent with GEJ/Siewert naming threshold
fail_condition: Explicit tumor-center distance conflicts with recorded GEJ/Siewert naming threshold
na_condition: No explicit tumor-center distance; only upper/lower bounds; trigger absent
positive_boundary_example: Diagnosis mentions Siewert II and tumor-center distance relative to Z-line/dentate line falls within the frozen Siewert II interval
negative_boundary_example: Diagnosis states Siewert I but tumor center is documented as Z-line below 6.0 cm under the frozen threshold policy
adjudication_conflict_policy: H5 is judged only after an explicit tumor-center distance exists; missing center distance is NA for H5 and may be H4 FAIL if localization completeness is absent

rule_name: Required record elements and diagnosis naming
source_basis: Local outpatient template completeness and diagnosis-naming audit policy; not an external ICD or treatment-guideline requirement
source_citation_mapping: H6 is an institution-specific template and naming policy; disease-context guidance supports diagnosis reviewability context but does not define the 12-field threshold, and ICD codes are not required
annotation_manual_location: annotation_manual_v1.0 Section 2 H6 and Section 3 H6
pass_minimum: The 12 required fields are present with non-empty values and diagnosis naming is reviewable with explicit site and malignant nature
fail_condition: Any required field is absent or empty; diagnosis naming cannot be reviewed for site or malignant nature
na_condition: Usually not applicable only if no record is available for auditing
positive_boundary_example: All required fields are present; terse non-empty values such as no special history, see present illness, or family consultation are acceptable
negative_boundary_example: A required field heading is missing or present with an empty value; diagnosis is too vague to review; absence of ICD code alone is not FAIL
adjudication_conflict_policy: H6 is judged independently from disease-specific evidence rules; terse but non-empty fields pass the completeness check
